layers.css: .card{box-sizing:border-box;height:100%;padding:40px;border-radius:28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-family:Inter;color:#f5f7fb;display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:28px;align-content:start} .card img{width:120px;height:120px} h2{margin:0;font-size:52px;letter-spacing:-1.5px} p{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:24px;color:#97a0b6;line-height:1.45} em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal} .bar{grid-column:1 / 3;height:14px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden} .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:calc(var(--progress) * 100%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b5cf6,var(--accent))} .tags{display:flex;gap:12px;grid-column:2} .tags span{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:20px;animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.6,1) both paused;animation-delay:calc(var(--t) * -1s + .3s)} .tags span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:calc(var(--t) * -1s + .45s)} @keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
